panels.caption: One hundred and twenty arrivals become one impossible creature made from music and light.

panels.text: One island has been chosen to host. Banners from all 120 worlds unfold above its Arena.
Every delegation offers a game that expresses something its culture values: timing, patience, courage, invention, or cooperation.
Your Arena ranking shapes the programme: flashes for the games you like least, fast fights in the middle, and full runs for favourites.
For the first time, all 120 Arena signals are routed through one championship network.
No delegation planned the sky-whale. It appears only when every world adds its note—and vanishes the moment anyone tries to claim it.
